supervision_contract.matcher: Nearest-centroid sampled query union target-seeded queries; not mask-IoU assignment.
supervision_contract.indicator: loss_indi uses matched positives; deployed scores are positive-class softmax of indis.
supervision_contract.mask: Matched query masks receive target BCE/Dice; separate score regression is not deployed indis.
supervision_contract.scope: Static source interpretation plus observed labels; no counterfactual gradient or efficacy claim.

registered_pairs.subgroup_status: Post-outcome descriptive decompositions, not replacement primary tests.

limitations: TRAIN failure-selected and target-informed; no population or held-out efficacy estimate.
Registered 65-pair endpoint is unchanged. Subgroups and all follow-ups are descriptive.
Prototype exclusion changes support and may empty it; same rows do not imply causal control.
Normalized annotation class names are not a full semantic ontology.
No new mechanism, native backward, resource gate, or training admission is established.
